title: fix(plugin-list): forward a gantt view's authored `navigation` down the view-schema path (objectui#7334)
body:
Part of #7334 — deliberately `Part of` and not a closing keyword: retiring that card is triage's call, not this PR's. Closes #9114, which this PR's second leg repairs. Route A throughout; this takes no ruling on #7210 half 2 and does not wake #7333.

## Two legs, and why both belong on this card

**Leg 1 — `@object-ui/plugin-list`: the authored key reaches the component.**

`ObjectGantt` owns a record drawer of its own and resolves

```
const navConfig = schema.navigation ?? { mode: 'drawer' };
const navIsOverlay = navConfig.mode === 'drawer' || 'modal' || 'split' || 'popover';
```

so it understands four overlay modes. Nothing ever put `navigation` on the node it receives: `ListView`'s shared `baseProps` declares no such key, and the `case 'gantt'` branch of `viewComponentSchema` added only `data`, the date/progress/dependency/title bindings and the two gantt config bags. That `??` was therefore the ONLY branch ever taken — a view authoring `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` (or `modal`, or `split`) rendered a gantt that opened a drawer, with no diagnostic. The key is already authorable and already read; this restores declared = enforced and adds **no new authorable key**.

**Leg 2 — `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`: the reached key has somewhere to go.** Added after seat review, on this card because leg 1 is what causes the gap.

Leg 1 alone made `mode: 'page'` reachable and **inert**. `useNavigationOverlay`'s `page` branch calls `onNavigate` and then returns with no fallback; `ObjectGantt` supplied none; and `ObjectGanttRenderer` hands it no host `onRowClick` either — this card's own premise. Both carriers empty at once:

| authored on a gantt | before this PR | leg 1 alone | leg 1 + leg 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drawer` (or unauthored) | drawer | drawer | drawer |
| `modal` / `split` / `popover` | drawer | drawer (#9113 — outcome unchanged) | drawer (#9113 — outcome unchanged) |
| **`page`** | drawer — wrong, but the record opens | ⛔ **nothing happens** | ⭐ **navigates to the record page** |
| `new_window` | drawer | new tab at the **unprefixed** `/duly_task/record/1` | new tab at the app-prefixed href |
| `none` | drawer | inert | inert |

`ObjectGantt` now supplies its own `onNavigate`. The destination is the record-page href the component **already** computes for the drawer's full-page link, so a `page` click and the drawer's "open full page" affordance cannot diverge. The row is looked up again rather than the id templated, because a mixed-object gantt (`ganttConfig.objectField`) routes a row to ITS OWN object and an id alone cannot answer that. Same-tab navigation uses the history + `popstate` pair, matching `DashboardRenderer` and `PageHeader`, because every href `deriveRecordPageHref` builds is app-relative.

⛔ **No host prop is forwarded to the chart.** Nothing is taken from `ObjectGanttRenderer`, no `{...props}` is spread anywhere, #7210 half 2 stays untouched and unruled, and #7333 is not woken.

## The judgement call, and the measured reason for it

Triage and dispatch both asked for a stated reason: `baseProps` (shared by every view type) or the `case 'gantt'` branch only?

**The `case 'gantt'` branch. This is a measurement, not a preference.**

SEVEN other child views read `schema.navigation` for themselves at their own `useNavigationOverlay` call — `ObjectGrid`, `ObjectGallery`, `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectMap`, `ObjectTimeline`, `ObjectTree` — and every one of them ALSO receives `onRowClick: navigation.handleClick` from `baseProps`. `useNavigationOverlay` gives an external `onRowClick` **full priority** over any `navigation` it is handed ("External onRowClick takes full priority", returning before the mode is ever consulted). So on `baseProps` the key would land in seven places in two broken ways at once:

| view | how it hands `onRowClick` to the hook | what `baseProps` forwarding would do |
|---|---|---|
| grid, gallery, kanban, map, timeline, tree | unconditionally | authored config arrives and is **outranked** — declared, delivered, still not enforced: this card's own defect relocated |
| calendar | `navIsOverlay ? undefined : onRowClick` (mirrors gantt) | **genuine behaviour change** — today its `navConfig` is always the `{ mode: 'drawer' }` fallback so it suppresses the host handler; fed an authored `page` it would stop suppressing and defer to ListView's overlay |
| **gantt** | `navIsOverlay ? undefined : onRowClick`, but its wrapper forwards **no host props at all** (#7210 / #7222) | the schema path is the only live carrier; there is no `onRowClick` there to outrank anything |

That is exactly the "two sources of truth for one question" the dispatch named. Gantt is the only branch where forwarding **settles** the question instead of splitting it. Five of those seven are pinned as cross-view cases: each still gets NO `navigation` key, and each is asserted to be receiving `onRowClick` in the same breath, so the negative reading is a measurement and not an empty harness.

The spread is conditional, so a view that authors nothing still gets an **absent** key and keeps the component's `drawer` default — the same absent-not-undefined distinction the two non-axis gantt keys next door carry (#7499).

Line numbers were re-derived on a fresh `origin/main`; triage's were stale as warned. The dispatch's measured trap is real and was avoided: grepping `baseProps` for the word "navigation" false-positives on `onRowClick: navigation.handleClick`, which is the VALUE. Matching the key shape with `onRowClick` as a positive control in the same run gave 0 key hits and 1 control hit. New comments cite sibling readers by SYMBOL rather than by line (#8875).

## Acceptance — every pin asserts a mode or a destination, never "something opened"

The defect's shape is "a drawer opens anyway", so a test asserting only that something opened is blind to it by construction. Three files, failing for three different reasons:

**`plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.ganttNavigationForward-7334.test.tsx`** (11) — the forwarding. Authored `page` reaches the node as `page`, authored `modal` as `modal`, the whole block (`mode` + `view` + `size`) verbatim; no authored navigation gives an absent key; positive control first; a control that the rest of the gantt branch is unchanged; five cross-view cases.

**`plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.navigationModeResolution-7334.test.tsx`** (6) — the resolution, on the REAL component through the registry, instrumented by a pass-through spy on its own `useNavigationOverlay` call so the value read is the component's own `navConfig` and not a second copy of its `??`. Authored `page` resolves `page` / `isOverlay: false`; `modal` and `split` resolve themselves / `isOverlay: true`; **no authored navigation still resolves `drawer`**; all seven spec modes classified.

**`plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.navigationPageSink-7334.test.tsx`** (7, new with leg 2) — the destination. A real task click under an authored `page` asserts the navigation **arguments**: `pushState({}, '', '/console/duly_task/record/1')` exactly once, a `popstate` dispatched, and `location.pathname` moved. `deriveRecordPageHref` is deliberately **not** mocked and the harness parks the document on `/console/duly_task/views/all` first, so the `/console` prefix in that string can only come from a genuine derivation. Plus `new_window` asserting the prefixed href and `'_blank'`, two overlay controls that must NOT navigate, the unauthored regression guard, and `none` staying inert.

Why the second file exists at all: the four overlay modes are **not separable from the DOM here** — `drawer`, `modal`, `split` and `popover` all render the one `RecordDetailDrawer` in this component (that is #9113), so no rendered assertion could tell `modal` from `drawer` even in principle.

## Reverse verification — two ablations, direction predicted then observed

Both scripts carried `trap restore EXIT INT TERM` with an absolute repo root and restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` (never a bare `git checkout --`, which takes the mutation back out of the index). Both restores were proven **by state**, never by an exit code.

**Leg 1** — delete the forwarding line from the gantt branch. Predicted: the three FORWARDS cases plus the positive control red; the regression guard and all five cross-view cases green. Mutation proven on disk first (anchor occurrences 1 then 0; blob `853fe7f` then `a14929a`). Observed:

```
ABLATED plugin-list pin       exit 1 — Tests 4 failed | 7 passed (11)
  AssertionError: expected undefined to be 'page'
  AssertionError: expected undefined to be 'modal'
  AssertionError: expected undefined to deeply equal { mode: 'split', ...(2) }
ABLATED plugin-gantt resolution pin            exit 0 (green)
ABLATED control ListView.gantt-binding-7070    exit 0 (green)
```

**Leg 2** — delete `onNavigate: navigateToRecord` from the hook call. Predicted: the `page` case and the "hands the hook a sink" case red; every OVERLAY case green; `none` green; and `new_window` red **on its arguments rather than on the call**, because the hook's own `window.open` fallback still fires but has no app prefix to work from. Mutation proven on disk first (anchor 1 then 0; blob `21bb86c` then `b96f82c`). Observed:

```
ABLATED navigation-sink pin   exit 1 — Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)
  AssertionError: expected 'undefined' to be 'function'
  AssertionError: expected "pushState" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times
  AssertionError: expected open to be called with [ '/console/duly_task/record/1', '_blank' ]
    Received:  -  "/console/duly_task/record/1"
               +  "/duly_task/record/1"
ABLATED leg-1 resolution pin  exit 0 (green)
ABLATED leg-1 forwarding pin  exit 0 (green)
```

Restore evidence, both times: `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` empty, and `git hash-object` back to the HEAD blob hash exactly (`853fe7f`, `21bb86c`).

## Verification

Repo-root invocations throughout; exit codes captured by redirecting to a file, never after a pipe. Heavy runs serialized through `../objectstack/scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. The suite and lint numbers below are from the FINAL head `066c43e` (after the `origin/main` merge), not from an earlier commit.

| what | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-gantt/` | exit 0 — **Test Files 143 passed (143), Tests 1435 passed (1435)** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/plugin-gantt run type-check` | exit 0; each runs `tsc --noEmit` AND `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFiles` confirms all three new test files are in those programs |
| dependency-closure build (`turbo run build --filter "@object-ui/plugin-list^..." --filter "@object-ui/plugin-gantt^..."`) | exit 0 — 13/13 tasks (run first; before it the typecheck failed only on unbuilt workspace `.d.ts`) |
| `eslint . --no-inline-config --format json` (whole tree — population 4796 files read from eslint's own config, counts read from the json output, so nothing is narrowed) | all **five** changed files: **0 errors** each (warnings only). Tree-wide errors 95 across 79 files, unchanged by this branch |
| `pnpm --filter ... run lint` (the repo's own per-package gate) | exit 0 — 0 errors; 505 and 382 pre-existing warnings |
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `check:vi-mock-inherit` / `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | exit 0 each |
| `check:control-bytes` + a direct control-byte scan of all six changed paths | exit 0 / no match |
| `check:new-line-citations` | exit 0 — **0 new citations** |
| `check-changeset-presence` / `check-changeset-no-major` | exit 0 — 5 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset (now declaring both) |
| `check:changeset-claims` (landed on `main` during this round) | exit 0, report-only — **and the read it asks for was done**, see below |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on all six paths | NOT GOVERNED |

### The `check:changeset-claims` read, answered rather than skipped

That gate is report-only and explicitly "a request to read, addressed to the one seat that can answer it cheaply". It names **9** pending changesets whose bodies mention `ListView.tsx` or `ObjectGantt.tsx`. All nine paragraphs were read; **none is falsified by this change**:

- `6475-gantt-block-face-declared` and `6939-objectql-record-source-refinement` speak about `getGanttConfig`'s declared key set and `getDataConfig`'s three-rung record-source ladder. Neither function is touched; `navigateToRecord` only READS the already-resolved `resource`.
- `7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields` and `7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted` say the gantt branch invents no date axis and floors no non-axis key. This change adds a key, restores no floor.
- `7773`, `7780`, `8990` and `list-user-actions-collision-5398` are about kanban `groupField` / `groupBy` and `userActions` — all untouched.
- `listview-comment-pair-4559` says **its own** change was byte-identical at runtime. That is a claim about objectui#4559/#4966, not a standing claim about `ListView.tsx`, so a later behaviour change in a separate CHANGELOG entry does not contradict it.

## Stop conditions — reported

- **Could the repair be done without forwarding host props to the chart?** Yes, both legs. No wrapper change, no `{...props}`.
- **Does forwarding change behaviour for a non-gantt view type?** No. Measured for all seven that read the key; five are pinned. Nothing outside the `case 'gantt'` branch moves, and leg 2 lives entirely inside `ObjectGantt`.
- **Does the gantt itself get worse for any authored value?** This is the condition the seat review added, and it is now answered by the table above: no authored value is worse after both legs, and two (`page`, `new_window`) are better.
- **Is the component's mode handling wider or narrower than the four modes at the read site?** Report, do not stop — both, and #9113 is the part still open.

## Out-of-scope findings

- **#9113 — left filed, correctly out of scope.** Three of the four overlay modes collapse into the drawer: `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectKanban` and `ObjectCalendar` each compute the four-mode predicate and then render `RecordDetailDrawer` (a `Sheet`) with no `mode` prop, while `ObjectGrid` and `ObjectTree` honour all four through the shared `NavigationOverlay`. Pre-existing, outcome unchanged by this PR, and repairing it means touching kanban and calendar too.
- **#9114 — repaired here**, by leg 2, and closed by this PR.
- Noted, not filed: `GanttView`'s own `onTaskClick` prop type takes a GanttTask and returns void — it declares no event parameter at all, so `useNavigationOverlay`'s documented Cmd/Ctrl/middle-click "open in a new tab" convention is structurally unreachable on a gantt. Unchanged by this PR in either direction — leg 2 supplies the sink that convention needs, but the event never arrives to trigger it.

## Bookkeeping

#7222's "Consequence 3 — SUSPECTED, not measured" is settled statically in the dev report on #7334: the authored `navigation` was indeed not honoured, and the dropped `onRowClick` was **not** the reason — the component reads the config off its own view schema and was never handed one. #7222 is already closed and is ⛔ not edited here.

`origin/main` was merged in (not rebased) after the seat review; `git merge-tree --write-tree` reported no conflict before the merge, and the merge brought only `app-shell` and `scripts/` changes — nothing in either package this PR touches.
